summary: Final review PASS, including additional BLE target, multi-target, SD and Scripts painters. Previously reported two P2 findings remain corrected. No unresolved regression blocker in reviewed changes.

evidence.finding: Work text is owned across nested callbacks; views are populated after vector resize. Partial presentation uses full-width contiguous rows or one row at a time, preserving the 320-pixel stride. Frame/dimension/sleep guards checked.

Existing enabled-option selection and callback dispatch remain authoritative. Menu animation is tick-driven. Empty confirmation returns -1, Back cancels, and existing destructive config callers execute only choice == 1.
Canvas rendering preserves original layout and action handlers. Masking changes only visible text. Existing encoder/key navigation remains authoritative.
Empty/short buffers, clamped scrolling and glyph-width wrapping are covered by compiled production-function tests. Custom terminal geometry retains the legacy path.
Mapping preserves the 0x00ffffff transparency sentinel and leaves raw pixel/image data unchanged. Existing sleeping/renderTarget handling remains.
Review found only display layout and row count changes; protocol worker paths unchanged. Compact header obtains copied context and state via existing client lock helpers.
Firmware declarations use external linkage and one implementation unit. Host builds retain static header-only assets.

evidence.finding: UI adapters use supplied scan/card/capture/clock data. Reviewed radio/control algorithms and existing safeguards are unchanged; no synthetic measurements introduced in reviewed paths.

RESOLVED P2: runtime.main changes interpreter_state from 2 to 3 during JS_Call. Palette bypass now uses >=2, retaining explicit script drawing colours in both foreground states; compiled state-3 identity regression passed.

RESOLVED P2: the new info viewer previously drew only its first 8 rows then dismissed on any detent, hiding 10-line DEVICE PROFILE fields. It now calls existing ScrollableTextArea::show() so wheel scrolling reaches every row and Select/Back dismisses.

Encoder bursts cast to int64 before negation. Menu steps are bounded by enabledCount with positive wrap accounting; scrolling clamps a direct int64 target. INT32_MIN/MAX menu cases pass compiled production-loop tests.

Final CC1101 graph uses actual tuned frequencies and acquired RSSI. Unmeasured entries remain absent, buffers reset on range changes, fixed-frequency history shifts only received samples. SPI sentinel and acquisition/delay order preserved in compiled actual-function test.

Final BLE common painters retain action handlers. Device storage metrics guard missing mounts and subtraction; unknown battery is explicit. Word wrapping remains bounded and preserves unsupported glyph fallback. Custom canvas/terminal geometry remains intentionally owned by existing modules.

Additional painter review PASS: snapshot scan/sort completes before cached RadioRows are built; reserved detail Strings keep c_str pointers stable, and no rows allocate per repaint. Actual RSSI/metadata retained. Multiselect marks guard checked-vector bounds, and counts use supplied rows/targets. Empty and unavailable canvas paths are safe.

SD and Scripts name pointers refer to immutable local String arrays that outlive the selection loop. Input/action tails for SD, Scripts, single-target and multi-target selectors are byte-identical to 6ade36dd after newline normalization.
